blocks.text: IPC lets the renderer ask the main process for an approved result. Expose one named function, not a general-purpose message sender.

Use a local Electron project with electron installed as a dev dependency and main.cjs as its main file. Run with npx electron . after creating package.json and index.html. These APIs do not run in a web-page playground.

blocks.title: Ask the main process a narrow question

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `contextBridge` exposes only the named approved value or function to the page. It should not expose all Node or IPC methods.
`invoke` asks for one named main-process operation and returns a promise for its reply.
The sender-frame check restricts which frame may call the approved main-process operation.

blocks.text: With the shown handler registered in main, the renderer can await window.club.getVersion().

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Import ipcMain in main.cjs and validate the sender. Do not expose ipcRenderer itself to the page.
